macros.name: addclass
macros.doc: \addclass adds a class, ⟨classID⟩, to the current semester.

macros.name: bibdef
macros.doc: \bibdef is used to set a list of bibliographies, one per issued command.

macros.name: TabEtp
macros.doc: \TabEtp will construct a longtable with all classes associated with ⟨semID⟩.

macros.name: TabTopic
macros.doc: \TabTopic will construct a longtable with all classes associated with a ⟨topicID⟩.

macros.name: topicdef
macros.doc: defines ⟨topicID⟩ (to be used when describing a class) and associates a ⟨text⟩ description and a ⟨color⟩ (for topic highlight).
